Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, o As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2
    Case 1
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2(After:=wb.Sheets(1))
    Case 2
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2(Count:=2)
    Case 3
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2(Before:=wb.Sheets(1), Count:=2)
    Case 4
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2(NewLayout:=True)
    Case 5
        Set o = wb.Sheets.Add2(Count:=0)
    Case 6
        Set o = wb.Worksheets.Add2
    Case 7
        Set o = wb.Worksheets.Add2(After:=wb.Sheets(1))
    End Select
    Tried = Err.Number & " " & wb.Sheets.Count
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
